label: The sk-code routing example uses a fixed <<'TASK' heredoc delimiter. A task containing a line exactly equal to TASK closes stdin early; subsequent task lines are parsed as shell commands instead of being passed to the router. A harmless shell probe confirmed that the tail runs. This contradicts the release claim that the quoted heredoc keeps task text inert.
